chunks: We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his nobles. He said: "I have been sent by the Lord of all the worlds."
ai.seo_question: Who did God send Moses to with His signs?
ai.summary: This verse, from Surah Az-Zukhruf, underscores the continuity of divine mission by linking Moses' (AS) prophethood to the broader narrative of revelation, emphasizing his authority derived directly from the Lord of the worlds. In Shia exegesis, this declaration serves as a foundational proof for the legitimacy of prophets as divinely appointed guides, contrasting their truth with the arrogance of contemporary rulers like Pharaoh. The mention of 'his elite' (mal'ih) highlights the specific political and social structures Moses confronted, illustrating the universal struggle between divine truth and earthly power.
